title: The Surrender of Calais: A Play, in Three Acts
summary: "The Surrender of Calais: A Play, in Three Acts" by George Colman is a historical play written in 1791. Set during the Siege of Calais in 1346-47, this work blends tragedy and comedy against the backdrop of Edward III's campaign during the Hundred Years War. With music composed by Samuel Arnold, it became the most popular production of the season at London's Theatre Royal, Haymarket, capturing audiences with its dramatic portrayal of this pivotal medieval conflict.
